cues: The two nitrophenols are separated by steam distillation.
In the ortho isomer, the O H and nitro groups are close enough to hydrogen bond to each other, inside one molecule.
With no free O H to bond to its neighbours, it is volatile and distils over with steam.
In the para isomer the groups are too far apart, so it hydrogen bonds to other molecules, associates, and stays behind.
